title: AI FINANCIAL ADVICE: SUPPLY, DEMAND, AND LIFE CYCLE IMPLICATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of explicit gender labels ('I am a man' vs. 'I am a woman') into anonymized user prompts to isolate supply-side algorithmic bias in financial advice, specifically measuring differences in recommended equity shares and portfolio allocations.
